PART - 2 - OVERHAULING / SERVICING WORKS, AND REWINDING OF MOTORS & TRANSFORMERS at Tataguni OVERHAULING / SERVICING AND REWINDING OF MOTORS AND TRANSFORMERS Overhauling / Servicing of 2300 KW, 11000 volts, squirrel case induction motor WEG make. The work involves isolating the power supply to motor, decoupling the motor and pump, disconnecting the termination cables, shifting the motor to maintenance bay after removing the base bolts, dismantling the motor (stator-rotor) and cleaning the stator and rotor with cleaning agents, replacing any damaged stator slot wedges, brazing any damaged rotor conductor to shorting rings, insulating the stator coils with Samicatherm tape wherever damaged and applying two coats of varnish (Bectol red varnish) to stator and rotor, removing both DE & NDE side bearings from the rotor shaft and cleaning the bearings and shaft with cleaning agent, cleaning the grease nipples and applying fresh grease. The IR Values and Resistance valves of the stator shall be measured with calibrated instruments. the motor shall be assembled and placed over the bed, terminated after alignment. The motor shall be run on NO-LOAD and then ON-LOAD. The alignment readings, bearing temperatures, vibration and noise levels shall be recorded. A fresh coat of paint shall be provided - shade GEM Light Grey 631 / Asian Paint Light Grey 6118. The work also involves replacing the bearing (DE side NU236 C3, 6236 C3 & NDE side NU232 C3) including v ring rubber seals and BTDs, using hydraulic press/jack, assembling the motor, fixing the motor couplings half, transportation of motor from workshop to Pumping Station, placing on the bed, aligning and commissioning the motor on no-load and on-load. Note: 1) The rates quoted shall be excluding the cost of bearings. 2) only reputed brand bearings and recommended grease shall be used. (Prior approval should be obtained if the motor bearing is proposed to taken up by outside agency).

Repair and rewinding of 2300 KW, 11000 volts, 6 Pole, squirrel cage Induction Motor WEG make. The work involves transportation of motor from pumping station to the work shop, removing the coupling using hydraulic puller, dismantling the motor, removing the damaged winding, removing and restacking the stator lamination after applying varnish, staggering and restacking the laminations with hydraulic press (if hotspot is detected or lamination is damaged), rewinding the stator with new pure copper wire, with insulation material (F Class) of same gauge & quality as per the original coils design, assembling the coils, providing RTD’s, brazing the end connections with silver rods, insulating the connections with insulating materials with HT tape, sleeves, assembling of the coils, fixing of HT termination bushing, both main & neutral connection using required new hardware items like lead bush, lead studs, impregnating the coils with insulating varnish in vacuum chamber (Vacuum Impregnation of varnish is a must) till the required insulation values are obtained. The motor shall be tested as per IS 325 or equivalent standards. The tests shall be witnessed by BWSSB Engineer(s). A fresh coat of paint shall be provided - shade GEM Light Grey 631 / Asian Paint Light Grey 6118. Note: 1) The rates quoted shall be after absorbing the released copper wire. 2) The rates quoted should be inclusive of all Taxes & Duties, Handling, Transportation To & Fro charges, Testing and Commissioning. 3) The warrantee period for One year from the date of commissioning Approval to the rewinding agency should be obtained from BWSSB before taking up the work.

Overhauling / servicing of 25 MVA, 66000/11000 volt Power Transformer OLTC/ Diverter switch including change of oil, excluding supply of new oil. The work involves isolating both primary and secondary side of the transformer, discharging the transformer static charge and draining the oil from the OLTC tank after removing the cover, all the moving parts shall be inspected and any damaged contacts (Fixed and moving contacts) and gear mechanism shall be replaced. all cables shall be checked for its tightness. The tap change mechanism shall be operated in both forward and reverse directions, both electrical and manual. Any defective relays and contactors in the OLTC drive unit shall be replaced. the tank shall be filled with fresh oil and new gasket shall be fixed. The dielectric strength ( BDV) of oil before and after filtration shall be submitted after completion of work. Spares for OLTC/ Diverter switch shall be procured from the original manufacturer only. The cost of spares shall be paid as per actuals.

The work involves isolating the power supply to motor, decoupling the motor and pump, disconnecting the termination cables, shifting the motor to maintenance bay after removing the base bolts, dismantling the motor (stator-rotor) and cleaning the stator and rotor with cleaning agents, replacing any damaged stator slot wedges, brazing any damaged rotor conductor to shorting rings, insulating the stator coils with Samicatherm tape wherever damaged and applying two coats of varnish (Bectol red varnish) to stator and rotor, removing both DE & NDE side bearings from the rotor shaft and cleaning the bearings and shaft with cleaning agent, cleaning the grease nipples and applying fresh grease. Part-2 OVERHAULING / SERVICING AND REWINDING OF MOTORS & TRANSFORMERS  Overhauling / Servicing  of  2300 KW, 11000 volts, squirrel case induction motor WEG make. The work involves isolating the power supply to motor, decoupling the motor and pump, disconnecting the termination cables, shifting the motor to maintenance bay after removing the base bolts, dismantling the motor (stator-rotor) and cleaning the stator and rotor with cleaning agents, replacing any damaged stator slot wedges, brazing any damaged rotor conductor to shorting rings,  insulating the stator coils with Samicatherm tape wherever damaged and applying two coats of varnish (Bectol red varnish) to stator and rotor, removing both DE & NDE side bearings from the rotor shaft and cleaning the bearings and shaft with cleaning agent, cleaning the grease nipples and applying fresh grease. The IR Values and Resistance valves of the stator shall be measured with calibrated instruments. the motor shall be assembled and placed over the bed, terminated after alignment. The motor shall be run on NO-LOAD and then ON-LOAD. The alignment readings, bearing temperatures, vibration and noise levels shall be recorded. A fresh coat of paint shall be provided - shade GEM Light Grey 631 / Asian Paint Light Grey 6118.The work also involves replacing the bearing (DE side NU236 C3, 6236 C3 and  NDE side NU232 C3) including v ring rubber seals and BTDs, using hydraulic press/jack, assembling the motor, fixing the motor couplings half, transportation of motor from workshop to Pumping Station, placing on the bed, aligning and commissioning the motor on no-load and on-load. Note: 1) The rates quoted shall be excluding the cost of bearings. 2) only reputed brand bearings and recommended grease shall be used.(Prior approval should be obtained if the motor bearing is proposed to be taken up by outside agency)

Repair and rewinding of 2300 KW, 11000 volts, 6 Pole, squirrel cage Induction Motor WEG make. The work involves transportation of motor from pumping station to the work shop, removing the coupling using hydraulic puller, dismantling the motor, removing the damaged winding, removing  and restacking the stator lamination  after applying varnish, staggering and restacking the laminations with hydraulic press (if hotspot is detected or lamination is damaged), rewinding the stator with new pure copper wire, with insulation material (F Class) of same gauge and  quality as per the original coils design, assembling the coils, providing RTD’s, brazing the end connections with silver rods, insulating the connections with insulating materials with HT tape, sleeves, assembling of the coils, fixing of HT termination bushing, both main & neutral connection using required new hardware items like lead bush, lead studs, impregnating the coils with insulating varnish in vacuum chamber (Vacuum Impregnation of varnish is a must) till the required insulation values are obtained. The motor shall be tested as per IS 325 or equivalent standards. The tests shall be witnessed by BWSSB Engineer(s).A fresh coat of paint shall be provided - shade GEM Light Grey 631 / Asian Paint Light Grey 6118.   Note1) The rates quoted shall be after absorbing the released copper wire.2) The rates quoted should be inclusive of all Taxes & Duties, Handling, Transportation To & Fro charges, Testing and Commissioning.3) The warrantee period for One year from the date of commissioning   
Approval to the rewinding agency should be obtained from BWSSB before taking up the work.
